title: How AI accounting startup Rillet raised $100M and became a unicorn in 48-hours
slides: Can a 48-hour funding round redefine accounting?
Rillet pitched AI bookkeeping to skeptical investors.
SoftBank committed $100M before the first demo ended.
Your finance team's workflows just became obsolete.
Audit your tools now before competitors do.
thread_text:
1. The 48-Hour Miracle

SoftBank wired $100M into Rillet before the demo even ended. No due diligence, no board slides — just a live pitch that flipped the script on traditional funding.

2. Investors Were Skeptical

Rillet pitched AI bookkeeping to a room full of doubters. The turning point? A real-time ledger that cleaned itself. Skepticism turned to FOMO in minutes.

3. Your Workflow Is Obsolete

If AI can close books in hours, your team's manual reconciliation is a legacy process. The skill shift isn't coming — it's already pricing you out.

4. The Audit Race Is On

Your competitors are reviewing their stacks right now. Those who wait for permission will lose the cost advantage. The gap between early and late adopters is about to widen.

5. Check Your Toolstack Today

List every finance tool you use. Which ones require manual input? Run a small test with an AI assistant to see what breaks. If you haven't, start now.
